about.title: Software engineer,
about.description_1: I'm Alexandre, a recently graduated software engineer from CNAM. Throughout my journey, both in education and at work, I've acquired technical and interpersonal skills across various domains: web development, system infrastructure, project management and even embedded systems.
about.description_2: A perfectionist by nature, I have a soft spot for front-end work: clear, well-organized interfaces built around the job of the people who use them. Front end or back end, I take care of architecture and code quality: SOLID principles, design patterns and conventions.
about.description_3_suffix: at a company where I can keep learning, tackle technical challenges and contribute to concrete projects.

timeline.title: Computer Engineering Degree (work-study)
timeline.description: Work-study at Weinmann Technologies, an industrial SME. Roles in the IT department: user support alongside the IT manager (50 staff), backups redesigned around the 3-2-1 rule (NAS and a differential sync tool in C#), Active Directory rights rebuilt on the principle of least privilege, and development of internal tools: Tempo (time management), Swing (order picking), Boléro (after-sales scheduling) and the Weinmann Client Portal (data visualization).
timeline.highlight: 2-month internship · Žilina, Slovakia — Research on electricity generation from trees. ESP32 embedded systems work and IEEE-format articles written in LaTeX.

timeline.title: BTS SIO - SLAM Track
timeline.description: Curriculum focused on web development and network infrastructure, with a SLAM specialization (Software Solutions & Business Applications).
timeline.highlight: Internship at Impact Web: e-commerce site with WordPress and WooCommerce — architecture, theme customization, product catalog and payment integration.

timeline.title: Bac STMG - Marketing Track
timeline.description: First steps in the business world and introduction to the fundamentals of marketing, management and communication.

beyond.intro: A good engineer is more than their technical skills. Here's what drives me the rest of the time, and often feeds into my projects.
beyond.photo_alt: Alexandre hiking through a field of tall grass at the edge of a forest

items.title: Cars
items.desc: Less the mechanics than how brands and models evolve, market trends and in-car technology. I follow F1 and WEC closely. That's where Sandy came from.

items.title: Strategy games
items.desc: Age of Empires, StarCraft II, Cities: Skylines: planning, managing resources, thinking ahead. Enough to want to build one.

items.title: Photography
items.desc: Street scenes and landscapes, on my phone or a Canon EOS 70D. A matter of detail and composition, just like an interface.

items.title: Sport & travel
items.desc: Mountain biking, padel, climbing and hiking the Club Vosgien trails. In 2025, a trip to South Korea and Japan that I planned end to end, the culmination of a long-standing interest in both cultures.

projects.title: My
projects.subtitle: Personal and professional projects, each telling a story: a problem to solve, a solution imagined, a concrete impact.

sandy.tagline: Your whole car's life, in one place.
sandy.shortDescription: A personal and family car-management web app — track expenses, fuel consumption, documents and maintenance, all in one place.

tempo.shortDescription: An internal time-management tool for Weinmann Technologies — activity logging, manager approval, and HR synchronization.

bolero.shortDescription: An interactive scheduling board for Weinmann Technologies' after-sales service — real-time view of technicians, customers and routes.

swing.shortDescription: A mobile order-picking interface for Weinmann Technologies' warehouse staff — replacing paper sheets with an app connected to the ERP.

espace-client-weinmann.shortDescription: A client web portal to view connected paint booths' consumption and status in real time — final-year engineering project.

fogwar.tagline: By day you build. By night you hold.
fogwar.shortDescription: A 2D isometric pixel-art survival RTS in a procedurally generated medieval world: build a village by day, defend it at night against raiders coming out of the fog.
